== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ライカー・ライジャード</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-63o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">密輸屋ではないキャラクターに配備して、密輸屋の技能を与える。または、密輸屋に配備すると、戦闘力に＋１（「意識操作」のカードの影響を受けない）。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ビムの商人で宇宙船用兵器の密輸屋。誰も信用しないくせに、誰とでも取引する。密輸の技術を教えている。ジャワ語に熟達している。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Rycar Ryjerd.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a character who is not a smuggler to give that character the smuggler skill. Or deploy on a smuggler to add 1 to power. Immune to Alter.

'''Lore:''' A Bimm merchant and smuggler of starship weapons. Trusts no one but will trade with anyone. Teaches smuggling techniques and is fluent in Jawaese.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4
* '''Printed subtype:''' Effect<ref name="jp-face" />
